executive_summary: This collection window (March 2-8, 2027) is the thirty-seventh archived window and the checkpoint several prior reports flagged for a transition decision on the Wales Bonner/Hermes menswear debut signal. Per SKILL.md workflow note 10, the CFDA Fashion Fund and CFDA Fashion Awards questions were checked briefly rather than re-litigated; both remain untracked pending new information. Fresh searches this window again found no dated post-show coverage of Grace Wales Bonner's Hermes menswear debut -- only the same appointment/anticipation framing (Istituto Marangoni, Uranium Waves, Wallpaper, Vogue Scandinavia, Euronews, FZINE Singapore) and the same separate WWD/Savoir Flair review of an in-house-designed interim Hermes Spring-Summer 2027 menswear collection, which is explicitly not her work and does not resolve this signal. This is the eighth consecutive window (2027-01-18 through 2027-03-08) this signal has appeared unresolved, four windows past is_prolonged_silence()'s default four-window threshold (first crossed 2027-02-08), and this is the specific checkpoint the 2027-03-01 report set for a transition decision. This report makes that decision: the signal transitions to 'untracked going forward pending new information' rather than being held at active weekly tracking for a further window. This is not a claim that the debut did not happen or will not be covered -- it is a call that eight consecutive identical-result search passes have exhausted the value of re-litigating the same absence-of-coverage finding weekly, per SKILL.md note 10's convention; any future agent that finds real post-show coverage should resume normal tracking immediately. A parallel check for Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 post-show coverage again found only forward-looking trend content and coverage of the concurrent, unrelated Haute Couture Autumn/Winter 2026-2027 week, not dated garment coverage of the January 2027 shows -- this signal remains under normal active tracking since it does not meet the same prolonged-silence bar for a status transition.
